evidence.quote: We verified the calibration against the June reference plates

observations.why: The collective 'we' performing verification against a fixed external standard enacts authority-ranking — calibration is validated against a reference that holds institutional authority over the result.
Labeling the instrument by name in a structured field enacts a classificatory authority over the apparatus — the label assigns institutional identity to the device.
Verification against a fixed reference standard enacts authority-ranking — the June plates function as the authoritative benchmark the calibration must answer to.
